# MakeMeRevise

> AI-powered A-Level revision platform for Edexcel IAL and Cambridge A-Level / IGCSE students. Personalised study roadmaps, AI-marked questions, mock papers, and notes.

MakeMeRevise helps students prepare for their exams with a personalised roadmap, AI-generated and AI-marked practice questions, full mock papers with examiner-style mark schemes, AI-generated revision notes, and exam FAQs that match real mark-scheme phrasing.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of the platform — AI notes, mock papers, smart study plans tailored to Edexcel IAL and Cambridge A-Level.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Free and Pro plans. Pro unlocks unlimited questions, mock papers, notes, full roadmap, and AI tutor.
- [Sign in / Sign up](/auth): Create an account or log in.
